author: arsalankiller
body:
Oke how this game works, I begin with a question like What is your irl name? then i copy that question to my reply,  answer it and make another question. The next one copies both questions and give his/her answer to the questions and every time someone puts in a new question so when you're the 9 person you have 9 questions to answer.

Questions about this game are welcome just message me ;) Skype is on my profile…

Rules;
-No inappropriate questions.
-Keep the questions easy to answer.
-Have fun.

~Wouter
p.s If the questions is getting to personal just type a - we will respect that.
p.s.s after a few questions ill make a reply with the new questions probably when we have around 5.
